title: A Hand to the Slate

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The figure goes on the slate before the man is looked at; that is the order, and an order is not an answer.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Clay Yard

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of four hundred and eight to four hundred and ten days, six months and two hundred and twenty-eight to two hundred and thirty days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody; count 408 exact at the opening on answer 390, closing at 410 exact on answer 396. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft is a sound from above and behind, the back room a shape and a dust, the out-of-line landing a report brought up the yard and never a sighting, and the yard well a stone lip and a bucket-round from the basket's low angle. Corin opens in the small hours of Ilmen 14 with the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 390 and the count exact at 407, the first arithmetic of Y.H. 814 gone up the clay road in Berr Clay's locked box with no key in any hand under this roof — one reading and not an account, not a signature, not a payer and not a thirteenth — and the fifth shaping of the well-saying found where put on its own tray with a finger between it and every other kept thing. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool; the empty place beside it holding the fold of wool Sella put there on the fifteenth, found where put and still a finding, not a placing; the thread of drool stiff in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — while the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning. Ilmen 20's second reading stands four mornings beyond the close, unbrought and not made a boundary.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Fourteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{408}{Ilmen 14, Y.H. 814, Fourthday}: the small hours opening on the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 390 and the count exact at 407, then first light and the morning's work; answer 391 filed, count 408 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects only. Walk-ons only: neighbours at an ordinary Fourthday's grammar. No Berr on stage, no Hessa sighting, no collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no slate opened within reach of the basket and no figure given for the boy. New day, new date, no recap: the hand on the fold is the present moment, not a retelling, and nothing from Ilmen 13 crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — crust two inches off with its corner hair-lifted, the fold found where put and still a finding, the thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint, the Afterdrop waiting — while the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict (T060/T086). He keeps four hundred and eight exact, six months and two hundred and twenty-eight days, against a house that keeps its days in loaves, glances and an unnamed space at the row's end, and does not stand the number up as a threshold or a figure (T071/T072). The fifth shaping of the well-saying is found where put and not repeated, named, made due or joined (T080 held). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals the thaw, turns them with a broken pot's back, keeps the charcoal unread and the grain covered and unfigured, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, carries him down and up at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven walked-around places, sets him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, and leaves the widow's mark untouched because a morning, a hearth, a shelf and a basket are not openings and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100, T077, T098). At the kindling Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip, passes his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, leaves the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word with the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, and does not repeat the degree toward the landing (T036/T076/T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the note three turns ahead, and takes his bent finger out of the cold damper without the extra holding of Ash 26; *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise ungiven (T062/T035/T031).

scenes.title: What the Fourteenth Day Left
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 14 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 392 and the count at 408 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard grammar (pail on stone, loaf pushed a finger's width and stopped, barley mouth to mouth, rake raised at the ridge and set down). The man from Slate Row whose name is on no roll stands again at the yard's edge with his hands loose, the patient face of a man who can wait in a doorway; nobody asks what he wants, he says no word that carries, no loaf passes, no slate is shown, and he is not made a sale, a witness or a tenth hand. No Berr, Hessa, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no slate opened within reach of the basket. Day already dated in Scene 1. Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the yard's small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather, goes around the seven walked-around places once and not twice with a look and a wide step and no number, widest at the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back, and keeps the wide step as a keeping and not a sign (T098, T009/T013/T092). He keeps the called-gone grey beside the left-in-place ridge with a finger between and makes no likeness a cause (T083/T085). The face at the edge is filed beside the older record-first hands and not counted among them, and the boy does not lay it across Tarn's ended term, the degree or Jorra's promise to make a cause (T080/T090 advanced, not paid). Sella at the going of the light keeps the whole hearth grammar, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure or handful and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and leaves the crack showing (T058/T079/T100, T077). In the small hours the towel comes out and the boy goes over the field by the place of each thing with every gap left a gap: crust's gap, shelf's two gaps, gone pan's round ring, field's empty place, keeping at the fold found where put, fifth shaping on its own tray, heard bell beside told with both gaps in their squares, six hearings with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside, nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, four rooms held apart, green and shape as sightings with no eighth, clerk's inward slate and Tarn's degree on separate places (T061/T082, T078, T081, T080/T090, T050/T051, T033/T034 held).

scenes.title: The Fifteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{409}{Ilmen 15, Y.H. 814, Fifthday}: the small hours opening the day, then first light and the morning's work, with answer 393 and the count at 409 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the ordinary morning grammar along the wall; Ilva is not on stage and no word of the landing has yet come up the yard. No Berr, Hessa, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross, bell or ownerless voice; no slate opened within reach of the basket and no figure given for the boy. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from the fourteenth crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order and reads the crust gone harder through another dry night, the fold found where put, the thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at the small bare wrist-joint and the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform, while the infant's three wants quarrel, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086, T097/T060/T086). He keeps four hundred and nine exact, six months and two hundred and twenty-nine days, against a house that keeps its days badly in loaves and glances, and does not stand the number up as a threshold (T071/T072). The first arithmetic gone up the road is not brought down; the printed figure stands and the figure read is still not the figure paid (T015/T041/T047 held). Sella at the hearth before the basket keeps the whole grammar: coals told the thaw, broken pot's back, intake/hold/letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand half over nothing, twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carried down and up at the half-pace, under the roof and never the Debt Loft, fold righted without a second fold, widow's mark untouched (T058/T079/T100, T077, T097). Tarn keeps six and the seventh, knife at the edge of its sill, hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held, *Six counted. The next I don't count*, ear-sentence stopped at the calling word, Seed 16 breath unspent, loan uncalled at the end of an already ended term and the degree not repeated (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust white in a fist-crease, not bone-coloured slip, parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, asks neither which slate was broken nor whether it was a birth-slate, speaks to the wheel before any person, withholds the full note from any High Kiln master who would call it early, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and out without the extra holding of Ash 26 (T062/T035/T031). Answer 393 filed; the carried fire gives four low pulls with the fifth unpaid four hundred and nine days and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the two counts standing side by side and never becoming one (T088).

scenes.title: The Figure Entered Before the Face
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 15 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 394 and the count at 409 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Ilva is offstage, her strip in her sleeve; Hessa is not a sighting and the fifth shaping is found where put. Walk-ons at the bucket-round and the yard grammar. No collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no slate opened within reach of the basket; the out-of-line landing is a report and never a room entered. Day already dated in Scene 3. THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, advanced and NOT paid: word comes up the yard that the soft-cuffed clerk set below the north bridge at the out-of-line landing entered a figure on his inward slate before he looked up to find the man who gave it — a hand to the slate before eyes to the person, reported and not witnessed, filed on a place of its own with a finger between it and Tarn's degree toward the landing and another between it and the face at the yard's edge. It is a reaching toward the loan that can hear, not the calling of the loan, not a tenth hand, not a rule, not a sighting, not a witness and not a payment, and the degree is not repeated as a habit; the figure belongs to no man standing under it and nobody under any roof is made a reader (T090/T080 advanced, not paid). Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the report apart as a surgeon takes a field apart — hand, eye, mouth in that order, the half-beat in the gap — and keeps it from standing up beside the degree, the face, the fifth shaping, the unread slate or the arithmetic gone up the road and calling itself a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T061/T082). Ilva's count stays in wood offstage and her ninth hand stays nine (T080 held). Sella at the going of the light keeps the whole hearth grammar with the grain unfigured, the charcoal unread, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand and the widow's mark untouched (T058/T079/T100, T077). Tarn keeps six and the seventh and does not turn his head toward the landing; the ear-sentence stays stopped at the calling word with the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006). Jorra keeps the shed's silence and the promise neither given nor withdrawn while the burned slate stands at five and the four ownerless Ash and Slate directions stay apart and unspent (T062/T035/T031/T065/T095). Answer 394 filed on the sixth place, not one of six a doctrine.

scenes.title: The Sixteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{410}{Ilmen 16, Y.H. 814, Sixthday}: the small hours opening the day, then first light and the morning's work, with answer 395 and the count at 410 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the ordinary morning grammar; the man from Slate Row's face, the clerk's entered figure, the fifth shaping, Hessa's eighth hand, Ilva's strip and Berr's box stay on their own places where put. No Berr on stage, no collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell, no second telling at the well and no sixth shaping; no slate opened within reach of the basket and no figure given for the boy. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from the fifteenth crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — the crust leathery past the point where a child would still eat it, two inches off with its corner hair-lifted, the fold found where put, thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint, the Afterdrop waiting — while the infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). He keeps four hundred and ten exact, six months and two hundred and thirty days, against a house that keeps its days in loaves and glances and does not stand the number up as a threshold, a doctrine or a figure (T071/T072). The clerk's entered figure and Tarn's degree are kept on separate places with a finger between and do not stand up together and call themselves a rule (T090/T080, T036/T076/T006 held). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals the thaw, turns them with a broken pot's back, keeps her finger along the top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, gives both proverbs to the pot and the fire and never to a person, keeps repair apart from restoration, turns the dressed grain under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and no figure or handful, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, carries him down and up at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven walked-around places, sets him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft and righted the fold without a look at his face (T058/T079/T100, T077, T097, T098). At the kindling Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, and tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count* (T036/T076/T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel before any person, knows the full note of a Vail pot three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withholds it from any High Kiln master who would call it early, and takes his bent finger out of the cold damper without the extra holding of Ash 26 (T062/T035/T031). Answer 395 filed; the carried fire gives four low pulls with the fifth unsupplied four hundred and ten days and Garl's name unspoken the same number (T088).

scenes.title: The Sixteenth Day's Close
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Ilmen 16 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the chapter, with answer 396 and the count at 410 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Offstage with keepings found where put: Tarn at kindling and flagstones, Jorra at the wheel-shed and cold damper, Ilva with her strip in her sleeve, the clerk's entered figure on its own place beside Tarn's degree, Hessa's eighth hand on its tray and the fifth shaping of the well-saying on its own tray, Berr up the clay road with the box locked, the man from Slate Row's face filed and not counted, the green and the shape as sightings with no eighth, and the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate reported at the out-of-line landing. Walk-ons only at the yard grammar. No second telling at the well, no market, no collector, no present-tense break and no \memory{} tag; no sixth shaping, seventh hearing, tenth hand, tenth stopping, eighth opening, signature, payer, witness or reader. Day already dated in Scene 5. Dramatic purpose: the yard goes on in its ordinary grammar and the boy takes the field as found and leaves it as found, going around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, once and not twice, widest at the returning-line place, and keeping the wide step as a keeping and not a sign (T098, T009/T013/T092). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry: a number rises out of a fist toward the well, looks at the light and goes back into a sleeve, and a woman sent to the pot gets no figure from a pot; the dressed grain lies covered at the rack end and the figure read on Ilmen 10 did not know what it cost, with no signature on the space between (T077). Sella at the going of the light keeps the whole hearth grammar, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure or handful, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carries him up the nineteen steps at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven walked-around places once and not twice, sets him under the roof and never into the Debt Loft, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and adds no second fold; the keeping is found where put and stays a finding, still not a placing (T058/T079/T100, T077, T097). In the small hours the towel comes out as instruments come out when a case is done and before the next is called and he goes over the field by the place of each thing with every gap left a gap: the clerk's entered figure on its own place with a finger between it and Tarn's degree, the fifth shaping between the eighth hand and the road saying, the face on its tray, the first arithmetic gone up the road in Berr's box with no key and twelve old findings behind one unsigned figure not laid across it to make a row come out even, the six hearings with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's knock outside, the heard bell beside the told with both gaps in their squares, the keeping at the fold found where put, nine record-first hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, four rooms held apart, the called-gone grey beside the left-in-place ridge, Berr's low saying about kindness entered on a place of its own, and the green and the shape as sightings with no eighth (T080/T090, T015/T041/T047, T061/T082, T078, T081, T009/T013/T092, T050/T051, T033/T034 held). Answer 396 filed: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the twelve readings, the first of the new count, the printed figure, the fifth shaping, the clerk's entered figure, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the river's skin, the widow's mark, the fourth direction, the clerk's inward slate, Berr's low saying nor the keeping at the fold; six honest answers stand on the sixth place, 391 through 396, not one a doctrine. Count four hundred and ten exact, six months and two hundred and thirty days told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the two counts side by side and never one (T071/T072, T088). The surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found and knows it costs nothing, which is how he knows it is not peace; under it, louder, the infant wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot board's handle and gets none of the three. Nothing was opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended, and no door was drawn across the tend; the house goes on as a house goes when a pot is set down in its place and the fire kept — forward, into Ilmen 17.
